# tree-sitter-lua for MoonBit

lua grammar for tree-sitter.

This module packages [tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-lua](https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-lua) v0.5.0 for
[moonbit-community/treesitter](https://github.com/moonbit-community/treesitter), the pure MoonBit
port of Tree-sitter. The parse tables are generated from the grammar's
`src/grammar.json` by the port's generator, which produces the same tables
as `tree-sitter generate` 0.28.0. External scanners come from `@scanners.scanner_for` in
`moonbit-community/treesitter/scanners`, the MoonBit ports of the C scanners.

The external scanner of `lua` is not ported to MoonBit yet: until
`@scanners.scanner_for` provides it, the language cannot be used for
parsing (`is_parseable()` is false) and the tests below skip.

## API

The package mirrors the grammar's Rust binding (`bindings/rust/lib.rs`):

| MoonBit | Rust |
| --- | --- |
| `language() -> @treesitter.Language` | `LANGUAGE` |
| `node_types : String` | `NODE_TYPES` (`src/node-types.json`) |
| `highlights_query : String` | `HIGHLIGHTS_QUERY` (`queries/highlights.scm`) |
| `injections_query : String` | `INJECTIONS_QUERY` (`queries/injections.scm`) |
| `locals_query : String` | `LOCALS_QUERY` (`queries/locals.scm`) |
| `tags_query : String` | `TAGS_QUERY` (`queries/tags.scm`) |

## Usage

```sh
moon add moonbit-community/tree-sitter-lua
```

In `moon.pkg`:

```text
import {
  "moonbit-community/treesitter",
  "moonbit-community/tree-sitter-lua" @tree_sitter_lua,
}
```

```mbt check
///|
test "parse lua" {
  let language = @tree_sitter_lua.language()
  // The external scanner is not ported yet.
  guard language.is_parseable() else { return }
  let parser = @treesitter.Parser::new()
  parser.set_language(language)
  let source =
    #|#!/usr/bin/env lua
    #|
  guard parser.parse(@utf8.encode(source)) is Some(tree) else {
    fail("parse failed")
  }
  let root = tree.root_node()
  assert_false(root.has_error())
  assert_false(root.to_sexp().contains("ERROR"))
}
```
